scripts.build:helper: mkdir -p native/bin && swiftc -O -target arm64-apple-macos14.0 native/CalHelper.swift -o native/bin/calhelper -Xlinker -sectcreate -Xlinker __TEXT -Xlinker __info_plist -Xlinker native/Info.plist

extendInfo.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Homework shows your Apple Calendar events in its Calendar tab.
extendInfo.NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription: Homework shows your dated reminders in its Calendar tab and keeps your tasks in a “Homework” Reminders list so they reach your iPhone.
